body:
# 🌌 SquareIO | Unlimited Open-World Skyblock

Welcome to **SquareIO**, the ultimate destination for the **Skyblock Infinite** gameplay experience! Powered natively by Modrinth's revolutionary [Skyblock Infinite Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) and built upon a heavily customized server architecture, we offer a massive, borderless multiplayer world. 

Instead of traditional, cramped islands, we embrace the endless progression and dynamic resource generation of **Skyblock Infinite**. Best of all? **100% Vanilla clients can join.** You don't need to download or install a single mod pack to experience everything our custom-tailored [Skyblock Infinite](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) world has to offer.

---

## 🚀 Unique Features

* **♾️ Open-World Skyblock Infinite (No Borders!)**
  Unlike traditional servers that lock you inside a tiny bedrock box, SquareIO opens up the world. Travel across the endless void, build massive bridges, meet your neighbors, and team up naturally in a completely seamless world driven by [Skyblock Infinite's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) progression mechanics.

* **🏝️ 17 Unique Starter Islands**
  When you type `/island`, you aren't stuck with just one template. Choose carefully from **17 different starting layouts** to find the perfect foundation for your sky empire. *(Choose wisely: island creation is permanent!)*

* **🌾 Dedicated Resource World & Custom Nether**
  Never run out of building materials. Use `/resources` to gather blocks in a resettable resource world. Plus, we've overhauled the Nether overworld-to-Nether ratio from **8:1 to 1:1**, allowing for precise coordinate management and easier exploration.

* **🛠️ Completely Custom Server-Side Mods**
  We run a blend of highly optimized open-source performance mods alongside our own **in-house developer creations** (like *BasicsMod*, *ClaimMod*, *EcoBal*, *RankupMod*, *ShopShelves*, and *SwordSight*) to deliver a smooth, feature-rich experience without requiring client downloads.

---

No pay-to-win mechanics here. Complete in-game tasks (breaking blocks, breeding animals, etc.) and use your hard-earned in-game currency to unlock powerful utilities across **8 distinct ranks**. 

Click below to reveal the progression tree:

## 🗳️ Voting Rewards

Support the server by typing `/vote` and get instant progression boosts:
* **Every Vote:** $100 In-Game Balance + 100 Claim Blocks
* **Every 5th Vote:** 2x Diamonds bonus!

---

## 🛠️ Server Rules Summary (Type `/rules` In-Game)

To keep our community welcoming and lag-free, please follow these core guidelines:

1. **No Griefing or Stealing**
   * This applies to ALL builds on the server.
   * Taking items or breaking blocks from unclaimed land is strictly banned, just like claimed land.

2. **Chat Etiquette**
   * Keep chat family-friendly and appropriate for all ages.
   * Use English-only in global chat (utilize private messages for other languages).
   * Respect all players and staff members at all times.

3. **No Automation or Cheats**
   * Auto-clickers, macros, and Baritone are heavily penalized.
   * X-ray, ESP, fly, reach, and hacked clients are strictly prohibited.

4. **Performance Friendly Gameplay**
   * Massive redstone builds or mob farms **must** have a physical ON/OFF switch.
   * You must disable your farms when you log off or leave the area.
   * Zero-tick farms are completely forbidden.

5. **Allowed Client-Side Mods**
   * Technical utilities like *Litematica* (hologram display only), *MiniHUD*, and *Item Scroller* are fully permitted.
   * Standard minimaps are allowed for navigation purposes.

---

## 🎮 How to Join

1. Open Minecraft (Vanilla or Modded Fabric/Forge) and go to **Multiplayer**.
2. Click **Add Server**, paste the IP listed on this page, and hit **Done**.
3. Log in, type `/island` to pick your [Skyblock Infinite](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) starting island, or check `/help` to open the interactive **Command Gateway**!
